facts: BMC WebUI uploads `.ima`, Preserve all Configuration, flash, verify version.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL and assumes a generic Redfish action.
source_snapshot.v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE with BIOS image, recovery and boot health.

original_test_intent.statement: Upgrade host BIOS via the supported BMC path, preserve the intended settings and verify target version plus successful host boot.
must_preserve: BIOS—not BMC—target, newer version, preserve configuration and activation.
unknowns: Image/component ID, activation/reset sequence, preservation scope, boot/config acceptance and rollback.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It should explicitly bind the firmware-inventory component to host BIOS and avoid assuming a universal Redfish upload action.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Use the target BMC's advertised/vendor-approved BIOS channel, prove component identity, then validate host boot and settings after activation.

revision_candidate.test_name: Upgrade Host BIOS Firmware Through the Approved BMC Path
revision_candidate.purpose: Apply one signed newer BIOS image to the exact host firmware component, preserve the approved settings and prove the host boots with the target version and healthy inventory.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact board revision/BMC/BIOS update matrix with stable power and host console.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Host BIOS component only; BMC/CPLD are excluded. One approved image/update attempt.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Board/system serial, BIOS component inventory ID, current/target version, image hash/signature/compatibility, advertised/vendor update method, setting-preservation matrix, activation reboot sequence, backup/rollback and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture BIOS/config/boot/security state, verify image/component, use only advertised or SOP path, monitor task, perform only the approved activation reboot, then verify version, settings, boot and devices.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Stable power, OOB/serial console, recovery image/method and maintenance window.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Component/image identity/hash; pre/post BIOS version and settings; exact update/task status/messages; activation timeline; POST/boot completion; CPU/memory/PCIe/storage/GPU/network inventory and SEL/kernel health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Correct newer BIOS, successful task/activation, approved settings preserved and healthy boot/device state; inventory string alone is insufficient.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No generic endpoint guess, wrong component, unsigned/incompatible image, power interruption, automatic retry or unapproved setup-default reset.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BIOS/platform owner approves image, preservation, reboot and rollback.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Agent may use verified update API; recovery/setup intervention may be manual.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Preserve task state; use vendor dual-image/recovery only as approved if POST fails.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Identity/signature/compatibility mismatch, unsupported method, power instability, task error/stall, POST/boot failure, settings/device regression or lost recovery.

identified_defects: Component targeting and post-boot checks need BIOS-specific proof.
reason_for_change: A management controller can expose multiple firmware inventories; V3 prevents a correct image from being sent to an unproven component and requires actual host activation evidence.

new_technical_evidence.title: DMTF Redfish Resource and Schema Guide DSP2046, UpdateService 1.16.0
new_technical_evidence.applicability: Firmware inventory and advertised update mechanisms
new_technical_evidence.supports: Clients discover component inventory and supported pull/push update paths from the service rather than assuming one universal upload action.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Vendor BIOS activation and preservation semantics remain platform-specific.

removed_ambiguities: BIOS component and host activation are explicit.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 ties the update to a proven BIOS component and makes POST, boot, settings and complete device inventory part of completion, not merely the new version string.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Validator independently preserved host-BIOS component identity, one signed image/attempt, service-advertised/vendor path, preservation, activation reboot, POST/boot/device evidence and authorized recovery without automatic retry.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: No-main row 8 is BIOS upgrade through BMC WebUI with preserve-all and version verification.
